summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-K6 admits no external crate. academic-admission reuses ciborium, ed25519-dalek, serde, sha2, and thiserror from earlier reviewed receipts; it adds only one workspace path package.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-admission is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns the sole compiled acceptance public key, deterministic-CBOR receipt verification, opaque verified capability, and exact two-posture serializer. Keeping them together lets CLI, IPC, daemon, and export consume one restricted Posture type without placing receipt signature policy inside the store, transport, or presentation crates.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. Its product host interaction is a bounded read of the fixed admission receipt and encrypted-profile marker below a caller-supplied profile root.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-admission links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
